script.title: Florida sank the Atlantic's fastest liner on purpose
sentences: Florida just sank the Atlantic's fastest ocean liner, on purpose.
On her 1952 maiden voyage, the SS United States won the Blue Riband, crossing the Atlantic faster than any liner.
Her top speed was a military secret.
Even the mahogany piano was approved only after gasoline was poured on it and lit, and it didn't burn.
Jets emptied her cabins, and from 1969 she sat idle for decades.
On November 11 she sank off Destin as the world's largest artificial reef.
The Atlantic's fastest liner now sits perfectly still.
script.description:
The SS United States still holds the Blue Riband from 1952.
On November 11, 2026 she became the world's largest artificial reef.
claims_en: Okaloosa County, Florida sank the SS United States on purpose to make an artificial reef.
On her maiden voyage in 1952 she won the Blue Riband as the fastest liner across the Atlantic.
The Blue Riband title remains uncontested.
Her top speed was once held as a military secret.
Her designers banned wood on board, apart from the galley butcher's block.
The mahogany piano was accepted only after gasoline was poured on the wood and ignited without it catching fire.
Passenger numbers declined because of jet flights and she was withdrawn from service in 1969.
She was sunk on November 11, 2026 near Destin and became the world's largest artificial reef.
